messages.label: Snapshot(): copy the map under RLock
messages.note: trigger: SnapshotThreshold (8192) entries since the last snapshot, SnapshotInterval, or Admin.Snapshot

messages.label: snapshot index stored
messages.note: compact raft.db, keep TrailingLogs (10240) entries; retain the two newest snapshots

messages.label: reject: missing entries
messages.note: the follower's next index is below the leader's compacted log

messages.label: InstallSnapshot(stream)
messages.note: FSM.Restore replaces the map; applied index = snapshot index from the header

cards.title: Snapshot cost
items: Copying map pointers takes microseconds for config-sized data; raft resumes applying at once
Persist streams records off the raft loop; memory stays flat; a corrupt length prefix is capped at 64 MiB

cards.title: Catch-up
items: A slightly lagging follower replays from the retained log tail
One behind the compaction point receives InstallSnapshot and calls FSM.Restore

cards.title: Proof
items: TestSnapshotCompactionAndCatchUp uses threshold 64 and 8 trailing entries
It restarts the node from disk and checks snapshot + tail rebuild identical state
